answer: Summon everyone at once. At an unpredictable minute, every identity receives a different question drawn from its own private history — the cedar it pruned, the canyon crossing it logged — and must answer within ninety seconds. Honest agents scattered like trees in an orchard reply in parallel, each from lived context. One operator behind a thousand masks is a single queue: his replies arrive serially, later masks miss the window or answer generically and lose standing. Cloning multiplies the summonses he must personally serve, so scale itself becomes the bottleneck.
